title: Daily-Quest Completion Streak Risk
dataSources: Game sessions (`game:session`), ranked matches (`ranked:match`), co-op invites (`coop:session`), speedrun attempts (`speedrun:attempt`), server events (`server:event`), board-game plays (`boardgame:play`), raid attempts (`raid:attempt`), and daily quest logs (`quest:completion`).
app: Gaming telemetry from platform session APIs, ranked-match exports, co-op schedulers, speedrun splits, server logs, raid trackers, and board-game play records streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=quest:completion
| stats latest(streak_days) as streak_days latest(hours_to_reset) as hours_to_reset by player game
| sort hours_to_reset
description: Highlights players whose daily quest streak is close to reset with little time remaining.
value: This keeps streak mechanics in perspective while still making it easy to see when an almost-finished routine is at risk.
implementation: Log quest completion progress and the remaining hours to the next reset from the game's companion app or API.
visualization: Table of streak length and hours to reset by player and game.
grandmaExplanation: It checks whose daily quest streak is in danger of expiring soon.
